files.name: translate-zt_en-1_9.argosmodel
files.provenance: Third-party Argos archive mirror uploaded by TiberiuCristianLeon. Commit-pinned Hugging Face file metadata publishes this SHA-256; its LFS history publishes the exact byte size. The hosted-file page displayed a Safe badge. The local archive matched the pinned mirror file and received a clean Defender scan during version 0.4 validation. Equivalence to the original Argos publisher binary remains unconfirmed.

files.name: translate-zh_en-1_9.argosmodel
files.provenance: Third-party Argos archive mirror uploaded by TiberiuCristianLeon. Commit-pinned Hugging Face file metadata publishes this SHA-256; its LFS history publishes the exact byte size. An independently hosted copy at https://huggingface.co/shethjenil/argostranslate/blob/main/translate-zh_en.argosmodel displays the identical SHA-256 and an observed Safe badge. This establishes matching hosted-file metadata, not equivalence to the original Argos publisher's binary. The local archive matched the pinned mirror file and received a clean Defender scan during version 0.4 validation. Equivalence to the original Argos publisher binary remains unconfirmed.
